description: This PHP source file defines the OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet class, which extends DashletGenericChart to generate a chart dashlet for visualizing opportunities by lead source in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for rendering options, constructing database queries, processing chart data, and generating chart HTML/JavaScript.

classes.name: OpportunitiesByLeadSourceDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying opportunities grouped by lead source as a pie chart in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Prepares and returns display options for the dashlet, including lead sources and user IDs.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JavaScript for rendering the chart dashlet, including chart data preparation and rendering logic.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the constructed SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by lead source.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw data into chart-ready format, including labels, keys, and totals.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to fetch opportunity data filtered by assigned user IDs and lead sources.
